Annual report license tax: Greater of $60 or two-tenths of one mill ($0.0002) per dollar of assets located and employed in Wyoming; e.g., $1,210,000 of WY assets -> $242. Minimum binds until WY assets exceed $300,000.

sutaDetail.notes: Wage base $33,800 in 2026 ($32,400 in 2025, $34,900 in 2027). New employers get an industry-based base rate plus four additional factors; no single rate (8.5% if registration incomplete).

notable: No personal or corporate income tax; the S election has no state tax effect (no state return to file)
Only recurring state cost for a small LLC is the $60 minimum annual license tax (https://sos.wyo.gov/Business/Docs/BusinessFees.pdf)
